senses.gloss:
धया mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं) Who or what drinks.
 f. (-या) A little girl, female
infant.
 E. धे to drink, affix श ।

धाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having, possessing, or who has or possesses.
 E. धा
to have, ण aff.

धाय्य m. (-व्यः) A Purohit or family priest.
 f. (-य्या) A prayer for exciting
fire, upon the addition of fuel. E. Irregularly derived from धो to
contain, with ण्यत् aff. or more correctly. धा-कर्मणि ण्यत्-युक् ।

धायस् mfn. (-याः-याः-यः) An upholder.
 E. धा to have, &c. असुन् Unādi
affix; also with a final vowel added, धायस.
